[NDBG.12.6.1] The adapter must offer these three filters as the
`exceptionBreakpointFilters` of its `initialize` response, and take them
through `setExceptionBreakpoints`:

| `filter` | `label` | Stops when | `default` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unanswered_call` | Unanswered call | a pump ends with a call still waiting for its answer | `false` |
| `fault` | Fault | a firing raises a fault ([LERR.9]) | `false` |
| `engine_error` | Engine error | a pump returns an error status, or the engine halts | `true` |

The stop is a `stopped` event with `reason: "exception"` and a
`description` naming what happened. With `unanswered_call` off, an unanswered
call does not stop the session: it is listed in the Calls scope
([NDBG.13.1.1]) and reported by `ds/callMade` ([NDBG.15.4]).
